name: Face Detection
description: Detect faces in images and videos, write .faces.json sidecars
whenToRun: STEP 1 of the face pipeline. Run after dropping new photos/videos into /photos/archive. Opens each file, finds faces, writes a .faces.json sidecar next to it. Videos are sampled at N frames and faces deduped across frames. Without this, new media has no faces detected. Narrow to a year/month dir for incremental runs. Use --force only if you want to redo sidecars that already exist (rare).

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory or single file to scan.

params.name: recursive
params.label: Recursive
params.hint: Scan subdirectories. Required if pointing at /photos/archive (year subdirs).

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-extract even if sidecar already exists.

params.name: model
params.label: Model
params.hint: InsightFace model: buffalo_l (large, accurate) or buffalo_s (small, fast).

params.name: frames
params.label: Video frames
params.hint: Frames sampled per video. More = catches more faces but slower.

params.name: dedup_threshold
params.label: Video dedup threshold
params.hint: Cosine similarity above which two faces from different frames are merged. Lower = more aggressive dedup.

name: Face Clustering
description: Run DBSCAN on .faces.json embeddings, write clusters.json, auto-assign to known people
whenToRun: STEP 3 of the face pipeline. Run after Face Detection if you want new faces to surface on /manage/faces/unassigned. Groups all face embeddings into clusters (Stephen's faces in one bucket, Patty's in another, etc.). Without this, new faces are detected but never appear as something you can label. Safe to re-run — assigned + skipped faces are tracked in Neo4j separately and get filtered out automatically, so re-clustering won't lose work. ~1 minute.

params.name: eps
params.label: DBSCAN eps
params.hint: Max cosine distance within a cluster (0.0–1.0). Lower = stricter / smaller / purer clusters. 0.3 is current production setting; try 0.27 if mega-clusters merge multiple people.

params.name: min_samples
params.label: Min samples
params.hint: Minimum faces to form a cluster. Higher = fewer but bigger clusters; faces below threshold go to noise (-1).

params.name: auto_assign
params.label: Auto-assign?
params.hint: Check to run auto_assign after clustering — assigns clusters to known people based on face_gallery overlap. Off by default to avoid touching assignments.json when re-tuning eps.

params.name: threshold
params.label: Auto-assign threshold
params.hint: Fraction of a cluster that must match a known person's face_gallery for auto-assign. 0.0–1.0 (0.85 = 85%). Higher = stricter (fewer false matches, fewer auto-assigns). Lower = more aggressive.

name: Build Face Index
description: Read all .faces.json sidecars, write embeddings.npy + faces_meta.json for similarity search
whenToRun: STEP 2 of the face pipeline. Run after Face Detection if you want the new faces searchable. Collects all face embeddings from every sidecar into one big embeddings.npy file — used by /manage/faces/similar (the 'find matches for this person' workflow). Without this, similarity search won't see the newly-detected faces. Rebuilds the whole index every time (~few minutes on the full archive). Skip unless you actually need similarity search to be current.

name: Object Detection
description: Run YOLO on archive (images + videos), write .objects.json sidecars
whenToRun: Run after dropping new photos/videos into /photos/archive. Writes a .objects.json sidecar listing every detected object (people, animals, vehicles, etc.) with bounding boxes. Independent of the face pipeline — no need to run before/after. Narrow the path for incremental runs.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory or single file to scan.

params.name: recursive
params.label: Recursive
params.hint: Scan subdirectories.

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-detect even if sidecar already exists.

params.name: model
params.label: YOLO model
params.hint: YOLO weights file (n=nano, s=small, m=medium, l=large, x=xlarge). Larger = slower but more accurate.

params.name: confidence
params.label: Min confidence
params.hint: Detection confidence threshold (0.0-1.0). Lower = more detections, more false positives.

params.name: frames
params.label: Video frames
params.hint: Frames sampled per video for detection.

name: CLIP Embeddings
description: Extract CLIP semantic embeddings, write .clip.json sidecars
whenToRun: Run after dropping new photos into /photos/archive. Writes a .clip.json sidecar with a semantic embedding per image — used for natural-language search ("dog at beach", "birthday cake"). Independent of the face / object pipelines. Narrow the path for incremental runs.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory or single file to scan.

params.name: recursive
params.label: Recursive
params.hint: Scan subdirectories.

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-extract even if sidecar already exists.

params.name: model
params.label: CLIP model
params.hint: CLIP variant: ViT-B/32 (fast), ViT-B/16, ViT-L/14 (slow, accurate).

name: Scene Embeddings
description: Extract DINOv2 scene embeddings, write .scenes.json sidecars
whenToRun: Run after dropping new photos into /photos/archive. Writes a .scenes.json sidecar with a DINOv2 scene embedding — used for visual-similarity search ("more photos that LOOK like this one", regardless of subject). Independent of other pipelines. Narrow the path for incremental runs.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory or single file to scan.

params.name: recursive
params.label: Recursive
params.hint: Scan subdirectories.

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-extract even if sidecar already exists.

params.name: model
params.label: DINOv2 model
params.hint: DINOv2 variant: dinov2_vits14 (small), dinov2_vitb14, dinov2_vitl14, dinov2_vitg14 (giant).

name: Archive Report
description: Scan archive metadata and regenerate report.json for Admin Overview
whenToRun: Run when the /admin/overview page numbers look stale — e.g. after a big import or after any of the extractor jobs above finish. Scans every file's metadata and recounts coverage stats. ~couple minutes. Safe to run any time.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory to scan (default: full archive). Narrow to a year for faster incremental reports.

params.name: output
params.label: Output file
params.hint: Path to write the .txt report. A sibling .json is also written automatically.

params.name: summary
params.label: Summary only
params.hint: Only print summary tables — skip per-file lists.

params.name: verbose
params.label: Verbose
params.hint: Show scan progress.
